name: image-annotator
title: Image Annotator
description: A picture on which areas are marked and named: drawn by dragging, or added with a button and placed with the keys (arrows move, Alt and the arrows resize, Delete removes), each named in a list beside the picture; areas come out as fractions of the picture, every change said aloud.

meta.when: Labelling what is in a picture: damage on a photo, rooms on a plan, objects for training a model, notes on a design. For cutting a picture use image-cropper; for named points that play at moments of a video use hotspots.
meta.example: <ImageAnnotator src="/plan.png" alt="Ground floor plan" defaultAreas={[{ id: "a", x: 0.1, y: 0.2, width: 0.3, height: 0.25, label: "Kitchen" }]} onAreasChange={save} />
